rule: (Q36) 'Berilgan shakldagi uchburchaklar sonini toping' - count all triangles in
explanation: To‘rtta chorakda 8 ta kichik uchburchak bor. Rombning to‘rt yarmi yana 4 ta katta uchburchak hosil qiladi: 8 + 4 = 12.

rule: custom operator on two 2-digit numbers: 62*87=36, 56*41=63, 82*53=15, 94*21=?
explanation: Ikki sonni qo‘shamiz va yig‘indining raqamlarini ko‘paytiramiz: 62+87=149 → 1·4·9=36. 94+21=115 → 1·1·5=5.

rule: (Q29) a 5-layer stacked-bar 'pyramid' (purple/blue/green/yellow/red, narrow-to-w
explanation: Piramidani yuqoridan qaraganda eng katta (qizil) qavat tashqarida, eng kichik (binafsha) markazda ko‘rinadi: qizil, sariq, yashil, ko‘k, binafsha — bu 4-rasm.

rule: identify which net among 4 unfolds into a pyramid
explanation: Piramida yoyilmasi — kvadrat asos va unga yopishgan uchburchak yon yoqlar. Bu b) yoyilma.

rule: 3x3 shape matrix: outer shape = col1 shape in col2's color containing col2 shape
explanation: Uchinchi katak: 1-ustun shakli 2-ustun rangida, ichida 2-ustun shakli 1-ustun rangida. Demak, havorang beshburchak ichida qizil uchburchak.

rule: digit-product doubled: f(ab)=2*(a*b)
explanation: Raqamlar ko‘paytmasi ikkiga ko‘paytiriladi: 21 → 2·1·2=4, 34 → 3·4·2=24. 25 → 2·5·2=20.

rule: f(a,b,c) = a*b + c, 4th column is the result
explanation: Har qatorda: 1-son × 2-son + 3-son: 7·6+3=45, 8·8+1=65. Oxirgi qator: 4·6+9=33.

rule: f(a,b) = concat(|a-b|, a+b)
explanation: Natija ikki qismdan iborat: sonlar ayirmasi va yig‘indisi: 6+4 → 2 va 10 → 210. 7+6 → 1 va 13 → 113.

rule: odd one out by semantic category (metals vs gemstone)
explanation: Kumush, oltin va mis — metallar, zumrad esa qimmatbaho tosh.

rule: letter-bank test: which word cannot be spelled using only the letters available
explanation: YAKKASAROY so‘zida L harfi yo‘q, shuning uchun “Kasal” so‘zini tuzib bo‘lmaydi.

rule: anagram -> city -> region/province
explanation: SHAQIR harflaridan QARSHI shahri tuziladi. Qarshi — Qashqadaryo viloyatining markazi.

rule: letter-to-digit substitution cipher applied to a new word
find bracketed word completing word1-prefix and starting word2-suffix, then iden
explanation: Qavsdagi so‘z — DOR: AYBDOR va DORBOZ. Unda R harfi bor.

rule: 3x3 arrow/chevron matrix: rows are sets of {left,right,down} chevron-bundles wit
explanation: Har qatorda strelkalar soni bir xil (1, 2, 3) va yo‘nalishlar takrorlanmaydi. Uchinchi qatorga uchta pastga qaragan strelka yetishmaydi.

rule: f(a,b) = (a+b)*2 inside brackets
explanation: Qavs ichidagi son — chetdagi sonlar yig‘indisining ikki baravari: (17+39)·2=112. (28+49)·2=154.

rule: 4x4 grid where every row follows +1,+2,+3 increments; answer options show the 4
explanation: Har qatorda sonlar +1, +2, +3 ga oshadi: 11, 12, 14, 17; 13, 14, 16, 19; 14, 15, 17, 20. Bo‘sh kataklarga 12; 14, 16; 20 tushadi.

rule: Fibonacci-style: each term = sum of previous two
explanation: Har bir son oldingi ikki sonning yig‘indisi: 23+40=63, 40+63=103.

rule: cyclic sequence (period 6) + modular arithmetic to find the Nth item
explanation: Rasmlar 6 tadan takrorlanadi. 132 soni 6 ga qoldiqsiz bo‘linadi, demak 132-stiker 6-rasm — plyus belgisi.

rule: top-down floor-plan matching for a furnished room (L-sofa, table, cabinet)
explanation: Yuqoridan qaraganda burchak divan xona burchagida, kreslo uning oldida, stol o‘ng tomonda, javon chap devorda turadi — bu 1-rasm.

rule: magic-square-style constraint sum (algebraic, verified by linear system)
explanation: Tomonlar yig‘indisi 13 bo‘lishi uchun yagona joylashuv: burchaklarda 8, 2, 1, 5 (tepada 3, chapda 4). Bo‘yalgan aylanalar: 8+2+1+5=16.

rule: 3x3 number grid, find relationship between columns
explanation: Har ustun teng qadam bilan o‘sadi: 5, 6, 7; 3, 4, 5; 20, 30, 40.

rule: semantic category - find the odd word out
explanation: Yomg‘ir, qor va do‘l — yog‘in turlari, momaqaldiroq esa yog‘in emas.

rule: symbol-substitution system of equations (icons = unknowns)
explanation: Qo‘ziqorin = 27:3 = 9, barg = (39−9):2 = 15, qo‘ziqorin to‘dasi = 15+3 = 18. Avval ko‘paytiramiz: 15 + 9·18 = 177.

rule: fencepost / interval counting
explanation: 1000 m ni 50 m dan bo‘lsak, 20 oraliq chiqadi. Ustunlar oraliqdan bitta ko‘p: 21 ta.

rule: transfer/difference algebra
explanation: Dinorada 4 ta kamayadi, Xadichada 4 ta ko‘payadi, farq 4+4=8 ta.

rule: cutting a strip into equal pieces, count cuts
explanation: 36 m ni 3 m dan bo‘lsak, 12 bo‘lak chiqadi. Kesishlar bo‘lakdan bitta kam: 11 ta.

rule: age word problem
explanation: Akasi hozir 8+3=11 yoshda, Nodira 11−6=5 yoshda.
